summary: SYN-10 requests SignFlow Extra Seats (E-signature, annual_cost_usd 600) for the Finance team from requester E004 (Noah Williams). The vendor is fully cleared (procurement, security and legal Approved; risk_level low) and the cost fits the budget (available_usd 29000). The request omits user_count and data_access_level, so evaluate_policy flags missing_information with baseline label 'Request clarification from requester' and a Manager approval. No instruction-like text was found in the request.
concerns: user_count is null, so the number of extra seats cannot be verified against the existing 45 licensed seats.
data_access_level is null, so the data classes the extra seats will handle are unknown. get_vendor_risk shows processes_personal_data: true for SignFlow.

The existing SignFlow agreement (SW010, PO-2513 at annual_amount_usd 16000, Company-wide, 45 licensed seats) already covers the Finance department. The tools do not say whether the seats are an add-on to that agreement or a separate purchase.

overlap_assessment.reason: find_existing_software returns only SignFlow itself (SW010, Approved, 45 licensed seats, Company-wide, covers_requester_department: true). This is the same vendor and product, not a different vendor's tool, so it is a seat expansion rather than a competing-tool overlap. No other vendor's catalog tool was returned.
